map.基于 EN13537 标准的睡袋温标对照，输入环境温度推荐合适睡袋: Sleeping bag temperature rating reference based on the EN 13537 standard; enter the ambient temperature to get a suitable sleeping bag recommendation
map.EN13537/ISO 23537 睡袋温标四指标：舒适(Comfort，女性下: EN 13537/ISO 23537 defines four sleeping bag temperature ratings: Comfort (women's lower limit), Limit (men's lower limit), Extreme (survival), and Upper; choose a bag by comparing the trip's lowest expected ambient temperature against the Comfort/Limit ratings with a 5°C margin.
map.：标准成年女性能舒适睡眠的温度，不感到冷: : the temperature at which a standard adult woman can sleep comfortably without feeling cold
map.：标准成年男性能蜷缩睡眠的温度，不感到冷: : the temperature at which a standard adult man can sleep curled up without feeling cold
map.：标准成年女性可承受 6 小时的极限低温，有失温风险: : the extreme low temperature a standard adult woman can withstand for 6 hours, with a risk of hypothermia
map.：低于此温度有严重失温甚至生命危险，仅作参考: : below this temperature there is severe hypothermia or even life-threatening risk; for reference only
map.以露营地夜间最低温度为基准，选择下限温度低于环境温度 3-5°C 的睡袋: Based on the campsite's lowest nighttime temperature, choose a bag whose Limit rating is 3-5°C below the ambient temperature
map.怕冷者建议以舒适温度为选择标准: Those who run cold should base their choice on the Comfort rating
map.高海拔地区夜间温度比平原低 6°C/1000m: Nighttime temperature in high-altitude areas is 6°C lower per 1,000 m than on the plains
map.湿冷环境保温效果下降，建议选更低温标: Damp cold reduces insulation, so choose a lower rating
map.睡垫 R值同样重要：夏季 R<2，三季 R=2-4，冬季 R>4: Sleeping pad R-value matters just as much: summer R<2, three-season R=2-4, winter R>4
map.按舒适/极限温标选睡袋。: Choose a sleeping bag by its Comfort/Extreme ratings.
map.高海拔露营按最低温选睡袋舒适温标，留 5–10°C 余量防夜冷。: For high-altitude camping, pick the Comfort rating by the lowest temperature and keep a 5-10°C margin against night cold.
map.舒适温标 0°C、极限 −5°C 的睡袋，0°C 舒适睡眠、−5°C 为生存下限: A bag with a Comfort rating of 0°C and Extreme of −5°C sleeps comfortably at 0°C and has a survival lower limit of −5°C.
map.极限温标能睡？: Can you sleep at the Extreme rating?
map.仅保命，舒适温标才体感好。: It is survival-only; the Comfort rating is what feels good.
map.极限温标能信？: Can the Extreme rating be trusted?
map.极限仅保命非舒适，选袋看舒适温标并叠加衣被余量更稳妥。: Extreme is survival-only, not comfort; it is safer to choose by the Comfort rating and add clothing and bedding margin.
map.睡袋温标对照是一款健康医疗领域的在线工具。健康指标计算工具，基于权威医学标准，数: Sleeping Bag Temperature Ratings is an online tool in the health & medical category that computes health metrics from authoritative medical standards, with all data processed locally for privacy.
